turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Good, good. Thanks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The grout in my shower has gone all grey and grim.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You can deep clean it, paint over it with a grout pen, or scrape it out and regrout. How much effort do you want to put in?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on, I'm going to chat with my friend for a bit. Just wait until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Daniel, quick, hold this reflector. No, the silver side.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Which way is the silver side? They both look shiny to me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The one that's blinding you. Tilt it up, toward her chin.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Like that?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Little more. Perfect, stay exactly there.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: My arms are going to fall off.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Twenty seconds. Can you manage twenty seconds?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Only if you buy lunch.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Daniel, go ahead and take the last slice.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Are you sure? Thanks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Daniel, did you remember to charge the camera?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's charging right now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done talking to them. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Still deciding how far to go with the grout?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Regrout. If I'm doing it, I'm doing it properly.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Respect. A grout rake makes the scraping much faster.
